user.title: Step 1/3: WeLock cloud login
user.description:
Log in with your WeLock app account. The cloud is only used to load your locks and, when unlocking, to compute the one-time unlock command.

**Note:** every login ends other sessions of this account, e.g. the WeLock app on your phone. Make sure the app is not in use right now.

select.title: Step 2/3: Select lock
select.description: Choose the BLE module of your lock. 'In range' means a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy of Home Assistant can currently connect to it.

verify.title: Step 3/3: Bluetooth check
verify.description:
Home Assistant will now connect to **{name}** ({address}, lock {device_number}) and request battery and challenge. **No unlock command is sent.**

Wake the lock up (touch the knob) and press Submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate WeLock account
reauth_confirm.description: The WeLock cloud rejected the login for {username}. Enter the current password. This ends other sessions of the account (e.g. the WeLock app).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the WeLock cloud (clientapi.welock.com.cn).
error.cloud_error: The WeLock cloud rejected the request.
error.no_locks: No lock with a Bluetooth module was found in this account.
error.not_in_range: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy of Home Assistant can reach the lock. Move a Bluetooth proxy closer or wake the lock up and try again.
error.ble_failed: The lock did not answer the status request. Wake the lock up and try again.
error.lock_not_found: This lock is no longer part of the WeLock account.

abort.not_in_account: The discovered lock is not part of this WeLock account.

data.battery_interval: Read battery over Bluetooth every (hours, 0 = only when unlocking)
data.local_unlock: Build and use the local command cache for offline unlocking (experimental)
